rules: The spinner shows 1 through 10, plus a death wedge.
The wedge is this year's death probability, as a fraction of the circle. Landing in it ends the life on the current square. No numbered move.
You resolve the space you land on. Spaces you pass do not fire, except Payday.
Payday adds your current salary when you land on it or pass it.
A stop ends the move even if steps remain. Then you spin again.
Ages 18 to 21 are a fork. Study and Work each have four spaces, then one shared track from 22 to 68.
At 68 the working track ends. Decumulation is not in this version. The only interest is the borrowing charge while savings are negative.

One point in the triangle sets health, work, and frugality. Weights are inverse distance to the vertices, so an edge does not freeze the far one. It locks when the path starts. The center is still one third.
sources: College Board, Trends in College Pricing and Student Aid 2025. Public four-year in-state student budget $30,990 in 2025-26 ($123,960 over four years). Net cost of attendance $21,340 a year. https://research.collegeboard.org/media/pdf/Trends-in-College-Pricing-and-Student-Aid-2025-final.pdf
College Board, Trends in Student Aid: 2023-24 bachelor's recipients who borrowed left with $29,560 on average. https://research.collegeboard.org/trends/student-aid/highlights
NACE Summer 2026 Salary Survey: Class of 2025 bachelor's average starting salary $67,983. https://www.naceweb.org/job-market/compensation/starting-salaries-climb-for-the-class-of-2025
BLS, employment and wages by typical entry-level education, median annual wage 2025 for high school diploma or equivalent: $48,050. https://www.bls.gov/emp/tables/education-summary.htm

BLS OEWS May 2025: construction trades workers median $58,150; electricians $63,190; electrician helpers about $42,661 ($20.51 an hour). https://www.bls.gov/ooh/construction-and-extraction/electricians.htm

NAR median existing-home price $417,500 in September 2026. 2025 Profile of Home Buyers and Sellers: first-time buyer median down payment 10 percent, July 2024 through June 2025. https://www.nar.realtor/press-releases/first-time-home-buyer-share-falls-to-historic-low-of-21-median-age-rises-to-40

FTC Consumer Sentinel 2024: median reported fraud loss $497. More than 120,000 reports lost over $10,000. Stolen identity on this board is an $8,000 hit in that serious range. https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2025/03/new-ftc-data-show-big-jump-reported-losses-fraud-125-billion-2024

triangle.note: Weights are inverse distance to the vertices. Income and the spending rate still follow axis() against one third. Health-related costs are one quarter of the spending budget. Total annual expenses = income × spend rate × (0.75 + 0.25 × health-cost multiplier). When savings are negative, expenses also include borrowing at 4% of the amount below zero. The center is the baseline for ordinary living, so cash moves by the gap between this point's annual expense factor and the center's, and then by that borrowing charge. At the center the living gap is zero. Salary follows the income multiplier.

spaces.title: Tuition
spaces.detail: Four years of a public in-state budget, due up front. The number is the price, not the average loan.
spaces.adapts: College path opening. Four years of the published public in-state student budget. No gendered campus.

flavorCards.caption: The cat became a loaf on the warm router.
The dog is wearing one sock and will not explain.
A pigeon took one fry and bowed.
The balloon is still on the mailbox. The party was yesterday.
The goldfish watched the whole film and forgot it.
The little trophy is holding a single sock.
Two eyes in the closet blinked and said excuse me.
Your shadow grew a tail and wagged.
The fridge hummed a lullaby. It was trying to help.
The neighborhood dog led a parade of leaves.
The ball found the net. The bench made a noise.
Your song came on between the cans.
Overtime. The popcorn hit the ceiling.
A bright speck crossed the roof. The chat lost its mind.
The ball left as the buzzer sang.

annuity.name: 2012 IAR
annuity.fullName: 2012 Individual Annuity Reserve Table, calendar year 2026
annuity.role: Reserve table for an individual annuity. Not a pricing table. The 2012 IAM Basic table is the experience table. The 2012 IAM Period table is that basic table with the LATF load, about 10 percent lower qx through age 100. The 2012 IAR is the Period table projected with Scale G2.
annuity.blend: Male and female rates are published separately. q is the 50/50 mean. SOA did not publish that mean.
annuity.youngAges: Published from age 0. Ages 18 through 68 are copied from those columns. No splice.
annuity.sourceNote: Payout Annuity Table Team, 2012 Individual Annuity Reserving Table, September 2011, Exhibit IV. SOA MORT 2585 and 2586 are the male and female 2012 IAM Period tables. MORT 2583 and 2584 are Scale G2. SOA page: https://www.soa.org/resources/experience-studies/2011/2012-ind-annuity-reserving-rpt/ . Checked October 2026: MORT has no 2020, 2024, or 2025 IAM, and the SOA tables page still lists this 2012 reserving table.

life.name: 2017 Loaded CSO
life.fullName: 2017 Loaded CSO Gender-Blended (50% Male) Composite ANB Ultimate
life.role: Statutory valuation table for ordinary life insurance. Loaded, so these qx are the higher public rates. The 2015 VBT underneath is the experience table and is closer to pricing. Pricing practice and the statutory table differ. This series is the statutory one.
life.youngAges: The workbook publishes attained ages 0 through 120. Ages 18 through 68 are the ultimate column. No splice.
life.comparison: 2015 VBT unismoke ANB ultimate rates start at attained age 25. A 50/50 of the published male and female ultimate rates is below this loaded CSO from 25 through 68. At 67 the CSO rate is 11.58 per thousand and that VBT mean is 9.985 per thousand. SOA did not publish the VBT mean. It is not a series in this spec.
